subject: Cross-account showcase | RSVP matrix & host rotation proposal
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice@databrew.com>, ops@edgecloud.ai
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cross-account showcase | RSVP matrix & host rotation proposal

Hi Alice, Samir —

Thanks for the interest in a short group showcase next week. We have a compact format in mind: 25 minute product lightning demo (focused on inference performance and cost controls) + 20 minute customer Q&A and breakouts. The goal is to let multiple prospects see the same flow while keeping the session interactive.

Quick asks so we can lock calendar invites:
- Please tell us which of the three proposed windows works best for your team (one reply with 1/2/3):
  1) Tue 9/7, 9:00–9:50am PT (US morning)
  2) Tue 9/7, 11:30am–12:20pm PT (US late morning)
  3) Tue 9/7, 5:00–5:50pm PT (evening, APAC-friendly)
- Any participants who need a private 15-min follow-up (yes/no + name)
- Anything specific you want covered in the Q&A (security, VPC, pricing, SLA)?

Internal note: tagging Neha to centralize RSVP matrix and Ben to own hosting and bridge. Soojin — please flag if APAC host needed for the 5pm slot; we may flip to an earlier APAC-friendly alternative if required.

I attached a lightweight RSVP matrix (CSV) and a short host rotation runbook. I’ll consolidate replies by EOD Monday and send the bridge invites.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
(Attachment stub: 20270903-rsvp-matrix.csv)
(Attachment stub: host-rotation-runbook.pdf)

From: Alice Chen <alice@databrew.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-account showcase | RSVP matrix & host rotation proposal

Thanks Marcus — 1) Tue 9/7, 9:00am PT works best for DataForge. Likely attendees: myself, CTO (Ellen Park), and two senior engineers (Jorge R. and Mei L.).

We’d like a brief note on data residency and keystore integrations during the Q&A. Also flagging that Ellen might need 15 mins follow-up for procurement questions.

– Alice
Head of Platform Partnerships | DataForge
alice@databrew.com

From: Samir Patel <samir@edgecloud.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Alice Chen <alice@databrew.com>
Cc: ops@edgecloud.ai
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-account showcase | RSVP matrix & host rotation proposal

Marcus — thanks for looping us in. Option 3 (5:00pm PT) would be best for EdgeCloud since our engineers are on PST but prefer a late slot. Attendees: me, two infra leads (Priya and Jorge), and our procurement lead (Rohan).

Two asks: can you confirm whether the demo will cover Dedicated capacity sizing examples (we run mixed workloads) and whether there will be a short slide on autoscaling + cost levers? If yes, we’ll mark 'private follow-up' as no for now.

Samir

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice@databrew.com>, Samir Patel <samir@edgecloud.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-account showcase | RSVP matrix & host rotation proposal

Team — consolidated responses below (see attached CSV). I created a simple RSVP matrix with preference flags and one required follow-up. Proposed plan:

- Final slot pick: 3) Tue 9/7, 5:00–5:50pm PT (keeps both EdgeCloud + minimal conflict for DataForge; DataForge confirmed 1 but can join later if needed)
- Bridge plan: Host Ben (primary), Marcus (demo lead), Soojin (APAC handoff), Neha (ops and breakout facilitator)
- Breakouts: two parallel rooms (1) Architecture/pricing (Ben + Marcus) (2) Security/compliance (Neha)
- Fallback policy: If DataForge can’t join live we’ll record and offer a separate 15-minute procurement touchpoint next week with Marcus + sales rep.

Attachments: 20270903-rsvp-matrix.csv (CSV) — columns [company, preferred_slot, attendees, followup_required, notes]
Host rotation runbook attached (host-rotation-runbook.pdf) — includes bridge dial-in, presenter order, and escalation contact list.

Ben, can you confirm you’re OK to lead the live bridge at 5pm PT and own presenter handoffs? Soojin — please confirm APAC handoff availability; if you can’t do 5pm PT we’ll tag Marcus for the entire session and record for Asia teams.

-Neha
Senior GTM Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice@databrew.com>, Samir Patel <samir@edgecloud.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-account showcase | RSVP matrix & host rotation proposal

All — confirmed. I’ll own the bridge and presenter transitions for the 5:00pm PT slot. Marcus — I’ll cue you at :00 for the demo, then hand to Neha at :25 for breakouts and Q&A. Soojin — please be on the call at :45 and take post-call APAC follow-up if needed.

Notes I sent to the calendar invite (also pasted in the bridge):
- Google Meet link + PST dial-in (see invite)
- Run order: intro (5m) / demo (25m) / Q&A (20m) / breakouts (optional)
- Materials: slides linked in Drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBCD-showcase-runbook)
- Post-call: record + hubspot note (HubSpot deal RDW-2027-DF-EC-341) — Marcus to follow with procurement touchpoint for Ellen if needed.

I’ve sent the calendar invites to all external attendees and internal hosts. See hubspot link for the event record and the RSVP CSV in Drive.

—Ben
